description: January 11 birthday meaning: Capricorn decan 3, birthday number 11, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a January 11 birthday falls in Capricorn, in the third decan, with Saturn as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 11. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Capricorn is cardinal and earth.

sections.heading: January 11 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Master number 11 stays unreduced, and on January 11 it meets the opening of Capricorn's third decan, sub-ruled by Mercury. With the Sun about twenty degrees into the sign, a practical earth temperament gains a quick, analytical mind and a strong intuitive streak. Readers often describe it as vision held to account by careful planning.

On January 11 the Sun usually sits at about 20° Capricorn, in the third decan, where Mercury is the sub-ruler alongside Saturn. Mercury, ruler of Virgo, colours the last decan of Capricorn, from roughly January 11 to January 20. The sign's practical ambition is joined by a sharp, analytical mind. These natives are often described as strategists and problem-solvers who plan carefully, communicate clearly and spot the weak point in a proposal before anyone else does. Their humour can be dry and well timed. Mercury adds a restlessness that may show up as worry about details or overwork. When this decan trusts the thinking it has already done, it tends to make decisions that others recognise as sound only later.

sections.heading: January 11 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 11th, you have a birthday number of 11, and because it is a master number it stays unreduced. The day of birth is a secondary number in numerology, yet master numbers are traditionally given extra weight wherever they appear. Two 1s side by side suggest doubled sensitivity as well as doubled initiative: the 11 is linked with intuition, inspiration and a nervous, creative charge. Those born on this date are often described as idealistic and perceptive, sometimes picking up on things before they can explain why. Grounding routines and trusted company tend to help them carry that intensity comfortably.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one January 11 birthday to the next: it is 1 for 1960, 2 for 1970, 3 for 1980 and 4 for 1990, for example.

sections.heading: Born on January 11: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A January birthday arrives in the depths of northern winter, a season of short days, stock-taking and fresh resolutions; south of the equator it falls in high summer instead. Most of the month belongs to Capricorn, with Aquarius taking over around January 20. In numerology January is month 1, the number of beginnings and self-direction, which suits a birthday that sits right at the start of the calendar. January 11 is the 11th day of the year. By January 21, 10 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Aquarius.

For the Chinese zodiac, January 11 always falls before Lunar New Year, which arrives between January 21 and February 20, so someone born on this date takes the animal of the previous calendar year. Well-known people born on January 11 include William James (1842), Matteo Renzi (1975) and Kailash Satyarthi (1954).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is January 11?
faq.answer: January 11 is Capricorn in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Capricorn, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on January 11?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On January 11 the Life Path is 1 in 1960, 2 in 1970, 3 in 1980, 4 in 1990, 5 in 2000, 6 in 2010 and 7 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 11 for everyone born on the 11th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on January 11?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology counts the year from Lunar New Year, never earlier than January 21, so a January 11 birthday belongs to the animal of the year before the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on January 11?
faq.answer: January 11 is also the birthday of William James (1842), Matteo Renzi (1975) and Kailash Satyarthi (1954). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
